title: Three ParA dimers cooperatively assemble on type Ia partition promoters
authors: Boudsocq F; Salhi M; Barbe S; Bouet J
one_liner_zh: 该文结合SPR实验与分子动力学模拟，研究ParA二聚体在质粒启动子上的协同结合与DNA识别机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但对象非典型转录因子。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Accurate DNA segregation is essential for faithful inheritance of genetic material. In bacteria, this process is mainly ensured by a partition system (Par) composed of two proteins, ParA and ParB, and a centromere site. The auto-regulation of Par operon expression is important for efficient partitioning, and is primarily mediated by ParA for type Ia plasmid partition systems. For the plasmid F, four ParA F monomers were proposed to bind to four repeated sequences in the promoter region. By contrast, using quantitative surface plasmon resonance, we showed that three ParA F dimers bind to this region. We uncovered that one perfect inverted repeat (IR) motif, consisting of two hexamer sequences spaced by 28-bp, constitutes the primary ParA F DNA binding site. A similar but degenerated motif overlaps the former. ParA F binding to these motifs is well supported by biochemical and modeling analyses. In addition, molecular dynamics simulations predict that the winged-HTH domain displays high flexibility, which may favor the cooperative ParA binding to the promoter region. We propose that three ParA F dimers bind cooperatively to overlapping motifs thus covering the promoter region. A similar organization is found on both closely related and distant plasmid partition systems, suggesting that such promoter organization for auto-regulated Par operons is widespread and may have evolved from a common ancestor.
abstract_zh:
摘要

准确的DNA分离对于遗传物质的忠实传递至关重要。在细菌中，这一过程主要由一个由两种蛋白质ParA和ParB以及一个着丝粒位点组成的分配系统（Par）确保。Par操纵子表达的自动调控对于高效分配至关重要，并且主要依赖于ParA介导，这在Ia型质粒分配系统中尤为突出。对于F质粒，曾有研究提出四个ParA F单体结合到启动子区域的四个重复序列上。相反，通过定量表面等离子体共振技术，我们展示了三个ParA F二聚体结合到该区域。我们发现一个由两个六聚体序列间隔28-bp组成的完美反向重复（IR）基序构成了ParA F的主要DNA结合位点。一个相似但退化的基序与前者重叠。ParA F与这些基序的结合得到了生物化学和建模分析的有力支持。此外，分子动力学模拟预测，翼状螺旋-转角-螺旋结构域表现出高灵活性，这可能有利于ParA协同结合到启动子区域。我们提出三个ParA F二聚体协同结合到重叠基序上，从而覆盖启动子区域。类似的组织结构在密切相关和远缘的质粒分配系统中均有发现，这表明这种自动调控Par操纵子的启动子组织可能广泛存在，并可能从共同祖先演化而来。
